messages:
jamie.leung: :rotating_light: Pagerstorm — suddenly seeing a big 5xx spike from inference-prod-west1. Alerts firing: INF-5XX-RATE and INF-LATENCY-OUTLIER. Paging oncall now.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-01. Paging: eng-oncall rotation. Alert links: https://alerts.redwood.internal/INF-5XX-RATE, https://alerts.redwood.internal/INF-LATENCY-OUTLIER
alexa.patel: ack. I'm on it — checking recent deploys and model rollout history. Can someone post any client/customer reports?
matt.nguyen: saw a small deploy 5m ago to inference-runtime (hash: a1b2c3). No immediate errors in deploy logs but will tail.
siva.ram: looking at autoscaler and pod eviction logs. Autoscaler shows sudden scale-down followed by scale-up failures (pod stuck in CrashLoopBackOff). Might be memory pressure from KV cache thrashes.
hana.kim: customer impact? I see increase in 5xx across trafficked routes; frontend reports ~4% error rate hitting production. Not yet a customer ticket but noisy.
jamie.leung: mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller local model for affected routes; 2) increase replica counts for runtime in west1; 3) temporarily reduce max_sequence_length on heavy endpoints to reduce memory. Assign actions below.
matt.nguyen: executing scale up now:
```
# increase replica set for runtime-west1
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/runtime-west1 --replicas=24
```
deploy-bot: Deploy scaling command queued: runtime-west1 -> 24 replicas.
matt.nguyen: scaling is in progress — 8 new pods scheduled, 3 are up healthy so far.
siva.ram: I pushed a temporary QoS tweak to avoid eviction: set ephemeral-storage and memory reservation on runtime pods. Patch applied: `kubectl apply -f /ops/patches/runtime-qos.yaml`
hana.kim: enabling fallback route for heavy customers: toggled route to `model-small-v2` for /v1/generate from heavy clients via routing-config. Traffic shift ~12% so far. Error rate dropping to 1.6%. :thumbsup:
jamie.leung: good. Keep an eye for pod restarts. Also collect a sample of error traces for triage.
incident-bot: Update: INF-5XX-RATE alert resolved at 1772004120 (scale + fallback). Logging retention set for incident.
alexa.patel: quick root-cause notes: we saw repeated cache flushes on the KV layer due to an uncapped sequence length from a specific client integration sending very long prompts. That caused memory churn -> pod OOMs -> 5xx.
matt.nguyen: logs: `OOMKilled` on runtime pods around 1772003603. Full stack traces uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/INC-2026-0315-01/trace.log
siva.ram: agreed. Short-term fix: add a hard cap in the ingress proxy for `max_sequence_length=2048` and a 429 if exceeded. Long-term: better KV LRU and eviction heuristics.
hana.kim: customer comms: I'll prep a note if we see any support tickets. For now flagging impacted customers via internal list.
jamie.leung: post-incident actions (we should capture these as concrete tasks):
- Create an alert tuning PR to reduce noise and add a rate-limiter condition to INF-5XX-RATE (owner: siva.ram)
- Add a dedicated dashboard showing KV cache churn, sequence length distribution, and eviction counts (owner: matt.nguyen)
- Update the oncall runbook with a new mitigation play for KV eviction and fallback routing, include commands (owner: alexa.patel)
- Open a follow-up engineering ticket to improve runtime memory safeguards and LRU (owner: eng-runtime team)

siva.ram: I'll take the alert tuning. Drafting rule change now. Proposed change snippet: 
```
- alert: INF-5XX-RATE
  expr: rate(http_requests_total{job=\"runtime\",status=~\"5..\"}[1m]) > 0.02
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: \"Sustained 5xx rate >2% on runtime\"
```
Additions: require `without(sequence_length)` and add `unless` clause for known fallback transitions to reduce noise. Will open PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4621

matt.nguyen: PR for dashboard created: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ABc123/runtime-kv-and-5xx?orgId=1. Panels: KV cache evictions, avg seq_length, OOM events, pod restart. Commented on PR with suggested panel thresholds. I'll own updates.
alexa.patel: I'm updating the runbook now at https://docs.redwood.internal/oncall/runbooks/runtime-inference.md — adding a new section "KV eviction + fallback routing" with step-by-step mitigation and commands, plus links to the dashboard and alert PR. Will add a short checklist and tagging convention.
hana.kim: proposed edits to runbook: include automated runbook annotations for alerts (example below) and an ownership table. Also add a 'customer-impact' quick-check template.
```
Runbook: Runtime Inference -> KV eviction
- symptoms: 5xx spike, OOMKilled pods, high KV evictions
- immediate actions: enable fallback -> scale replicas -> patch QoS
- pointers: grafana panel, logs s3 path, github PRs
- owners: alert tuning(siva.ram), runbook(alexa.patel), dashboard(matt.nguyen)
```
jamie.leung: assign owners: alexa = runbook PR and merge, siva = alert PR and monitor for 72h, matt = dashboard + set alert threshold adjustments based on new panels. Hana will draft a short internal postmortem blurb for comms.
incident-bot: Created ticket links: INF-TICKET-894 (runtime memory improvement), PRs: #4621 (alerts), #4622 (runbook), Dashboard: ABc123.
alexa.patel: runbook PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4622 — added steps, commands (kubectl snippets), and a recommended post-incident checklist. Please review.
siva.ram: alert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4621 — added `for: 2m` and sequence_length filter. Requesting review from eng-sre.
matt.nguyen: dashboard live in preview, setting panel thresholds now. Will sync with siva tomorrow to align thresholds with alert rules.
hana.kim: internal summary draft saved to /docs/incidents/INC-2026-0315-01/summary.md — will share for review by EOD.
jamie.leung: couple more notes for runbook: add ‘snooze’ guidance for noisy alerts during recovery (how to use alert-manager silence with owner tags), add explicit handoff steps if escalation to infra is needed.
alexa.patel: added the snooze section and an example silence command: `curl -XPOST $ALERTMANAGER/api/v2/silences -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"INF-5XX-RATE","isRegex":false}],"startsAt":"2026-03-15T12:00:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-15T12:30:00Z","createdBy":"oncall","comment":"Recovery window"}'`
jamie.leung: thanks. Last action: schedule a 30m postmortem sync tomorrow 10:30 PT (invites sent). We'll confirm the follow-ups and close the incident after owners resolve PRs and dashboards. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-01 marked as mitigated at 1772004120 and resolved at 1772007890. Follow-up tasks created in Jira: INF-894, INF-895, INF-896.
alexa.patel: will merge runbook PR after minor edits.
siva.ram: monitoring the alert changes; will report back in 24h with noise reduction metrics.
matt.nguyen: dashboard alerts updated, will pin to ops channel.
hana.kim: I'll post the internal blurb and share an external customer note template if any customers ask.
jamie.leung: nice work team. We'll close out after the PRs are merged and the ticket list is cleared. :tada:
